Report required Pokémon fields (id, raw height, raw weight, base_experience)
Report all types in slot order using exact API strings
Compute and report the highest base stat (include ties) from complete stats array
Open species.url and report species fields (color.name, habitat.name, capture_rate, generation.name)
Stop after recording all requested fields (no extra/unrequested outputs)

criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Pikachu Pokémon response and its returned species.url
criteria.final_justification: DOM evidence supports that the agent accessed /pokemon/pikachu, but does not support that the agent used only the supplied Pokémon response plus the returned species.url, because (a) `species.url` itself is never shown, and (b) there is no evidenced visit to a species endpoint while the agent nonetheless reported species fields. This is a controllable failure (fabrication beyond evidenced sources), so keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Report required Pokémon fields (id, raw height, raw weight, base_experience)
criteria.final_justification: All four required Pokémon fields are directly supported by DOM text and are reported as raw values (no conversions). Keep full credit.

criteria.criterion: Report all types in slot order using exact API strings
criteria.final_justification: Because types are not evidenced anywhere in the supplied DOM and the action history shows no successful reveal of that section, the agent’s specific claim that the only type is `electric` is unsupported. Under the DOM rule, this should not receive credit (not an uncontrollable blocker; just missing evidence with a concrete asserted value).

criteria.criterion: Compute and report the highest base stat (include ties) from complete stats array
criteria.final_justification: The agent listed all six stats and computed a maximum (speed 90), but the complete stats array is not present in the DOM evidence and there is no action-history evidence of reaching it. This is therefore unsupported/fabricated per the DOM rule. Score should be reduced from baseline full credit to 0.

criteria.criterion: Open species.url and report species fields (color.name, habitat.name, capture_rate, generation.name)
criteria.final_justification: Agent reported four concrete species fields and a specific species URL without any DOM-supported retrieval. Not an uncontrollable blocker; it’s unsupported. Keep at 0.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording all requested fields (no extra/unrequested outputs)
criteria.final_justification: Stopping condition is mostly met (they didn’t go beyond the requested scope), but they did include extra unrequested detail (the entire stats breakdown) rather than only the highest stat(s). This is a minor nitpick, so award partial credit rather than full.

limitations: DOM-model evidence cannot prove pixel-only color, styling, geometry, overlap, clipping, z-order, or unrepresented image/canvas/video content. Treat absent content as unproven, not false; source-declared truncation further limits coverage.
